semantics.edge: positive clock edge, as explicitly specified
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous: at a positive edge with reset high, q becomes 0; reset takes priority over counting.
semantics.count: At every positive edge with reset low, increment by one; after 999 produce 0.
semantics.between_edges: q retains its value, including when reset changes between positive edges.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified; no initialization is added. Verification establishes state with synchronous reset before comparing numeric outputs.

verification.oracle: Independent integer model based on the original 0..999 inclusive count and synchronous reset specification.
verification.sampling: Drive reset on falling edges or between edges; compare q after positive-edge nonblocking updates and between edges.
cases: reset pulse entirely between positive edges
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up output before the first reset is unspecified, so no numeric value is required before reset.
Recovery from unreachable states 1000..1023 is unspecified and is not tested.
